# peal

Peal API
- API version: 0.0.1
  - Generator version: 7.27.0

Schedule posts across social platforms, follow how they did, and manage a Peal workspace's channels, media and members.

  For more information, please visit [https://peal.social](https://peal.social)

*Automatically generated by the [OpenAPI Generator](https://openapi-generator.tech)*


## Requirements

Building the API client library requires:
1. Java 1.8+
2. Maven (3.8.3+)/Gradle (7.2+)

## Installation

To install the API client library to your local Maven repository, simply execute:

```shell
mvn clean install
```

To deploy it to a remote Maven repository instead, configure the settings of the repository and execute:

```shell
mvn clean deploy
```

Refer to the [OSSRH Guide](http://central.sonatype.org/pages/ossrh-guide.html) for more information.

### Maven users

Add this dependency to your project's POM:

```xml
<dependency>
  <groupId>social.peal</groupId>
  <artifactId>peal</artifactId>
  <version>0.2.0</version>
  <scope>compile</scope>
</dependency>
```

### Gradle users

Add this dependency to your project's build file:

```groovy
  repositories {
    mavenCentral()     // Needed if the 'peal' jar has been published to maven central.
    mavenLocal()       // Needed if the 'peal' jar has been published to the local maven repo.
  }

  dependencies {
     implementation "social.peal:peal:0.2.0"
  }
```

### Others

At first generate the JAR by executing:

```shell
mvn clean package
```

Then manually install the following JARs:

* `target/peal-0.2.0.jar`
* `target/lib/*.jar`

## Getting Started

Please follow the [installation](#installation) instruction and execute the following Java code:

```java

// Import classes:
import social.peal.ApiClient;
import social.peal.ApiException;
import social.peal.Configuration;
import social.peal.auth.*;
import social.peal.model.*;
import social.peal.api.AnalyticsApi;

public class Example {
  public static void main(String[] args) {
    ApiClient defaultClient = Configuration.getDefaultApiClient();
    defaultClient.setBasePath("https://app.peal.social");
    
    // Configure HTTP bearer authorization: bearer
    HttpBearerAuth bearer = (HttpBearerAuth) defaultClient.getAuthentication("bearer");
    bearer.setBearerToken("BEARER TOKEN");

    AnalyticsApi apiInstance = new AnalyticsApi(defaultClient);
    String workspaceId = "workspaceId_example"; // String | 
    String postId = "postId_example"; // String | 
    try {
      PostAnalytics result = apiInstance.analyticsPost(workspaceId, postId);
      System.out.println(result);
    } catch (ApiException e) {
      System.err.println("Exception when calling AnalyticsApi#analyticsPost");
      System.err.println("Status code: " + e.getCode());
      System.err.println("Reason: " + e.getResponseBody());
      System.err.println("Response headers: " + e.getResponseHeaders());
      e.printStackTrace();
    }
  }
}

```
